The round4 candidate reads '(וּמִי בַצָּמָא.) מִי בָרַעַשׁ.', which matches. The detail crop also shows the יורם gloss with its period inside the parenthesis, which matches the candidate.

In all five enlarged s234 refrains (stanzas 8–12), the only marks under לַעֲדֵי are a patah under the lamed, a hataf-patah under the ayin and a tsere under the dalet. No separate vertical stroke appears beside any of them. A meteg stroke would therefore be visible if it were printed. The seven s232 refrains show the same pattern with no meteg. The small vertical marks below some s232 lines are ascenders of lamed from the next line, not marks under לעדי. The candidate's metegless refrains are faithful.
